candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(callResult) check, so a failed ETH transfer does not revert the state changes.
Move the state update `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` to after the external call, enabling reentrancy.
Remove the `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` assignment, so the caller retains their internal credit after withdrawal.
Remove the `balance -= oCredit;` deduction, so the contract's balance tracking is not decreased on withdrawal.
Replace `uint oCredit = credit[msg.sender];` with `uint oCredit = credit[address(0)];` so the function checks a different account's credit balance.
Change the guard from `if (oCredit > 0)` to `if (oCredit >= 0)`, allowing the withdrawal path even when the sender has zero credit.
Replace `balance -= oCredit;` with `balance += oCredit;` so the internal balance accounting is inverted.
Replace `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` with `credit[address(0)] = 0;` so the sender's credit is not cleared before the external call.
Replace the external call value `oCredit` with `0` so the call transfers no ether.
Replace `require(callResult);` with `assert(callResult);` so a failed external call causes a panic/revert instead of a standard require revert.
Move the state update `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` from before the external call to after it, making the function reentrant.
Move the state update credit[msg.sender] = 0 from before the external call to after it, so the callee observes the credit unchanged during the call.
Move the state update balance -= oCredit from before the external call to after it, so the callee observes the old balance during the call.
Delete the require(callResult) check so a failed external call no longer causes the transaction to revert.
Replace the strict credit check oCredit > 0 with oCredit >= 0 so the branch is always entered.
Replace the read of msg.sender's credit with a read of address(0)'s credit for the oCredit local.
Replace the zeroing assignment of the caller's credit with leaving the credit unchanged.
Delete the transfer call so the function updates credit and balance without sending Ether.
Move the balance decrement to after the external call, so the reentrant callee sees the old balance and credit state during the call.
Move the state update `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` from before the external call to after it.
Move the state update `balance -= oCredit;` from before the external call to after it.
Replace the strict `if (oCredit > 0)` guard with `if (oCredit >= 0)` so that the body also executes when the credit is zero.
Delete the `require(callResult);` check so a failed external call no longer reverts the transaction.
Replace the condition `oCredit > 0` with `oCredit >= 0`, so withdrawAll may proceed when the caller has zero credit.
Delete the `require(callResult);` statement after the external call, so a failed transfer no longer causes withdrawAll to revert.
Replace `balance -= oCredit;` with `balance += oCredit;`, changing the tracked balance update performed during withdrawal.
Replace `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` with `credit[msg.sender] = oCredit;`, so the caller's credit is not cleared during withdrawal.

Snapshots the sender credit as the full contract balance instead of the sender's credited amount, so the subsequent subtraction and transfer diverge whenever the sender's credit differs from the balance.
Replaces the credit-clearing update with a write that resets the contract balance, changing state exposed to any re-entrant or subsequent call.
Moves the sender credit-clearing update to after the external call, exposing the stale credit during reentrancy.
Deletes the require on the external call result, so a failed transfer no longer aborts and the withdrawal completes with unchanged state.
Replaces the sender's credit-guard condition with true, so withdrawAll always proceeds and reverts when the sender has no credit.
Replaces the balance subtraction with an addition, corrupting accounting so that a nonzero-credit caller reverts on the external transfer after the balance is inflated.
Replace the condition `oCredit > 0` with `oCredit >= 0`, making the withdrawal branch always execute.
Replace `balance -= oCredit` with `balance -= 0`, so the contract balance is not reduced before the external call.
Replace `credit[msg.sender] = 0` with `credit[msg.sender] = oCredit`, so the caller's credit is not cleared before the external call.
Replace the external call value `oCredit` with `0`, so no ether is sent during withdrawal.
Delete the `require(callResult);` statement, so a failed external call no longer reverts the withdrawal.
Move the state update `credit[msg.sender] = 0` from before the external call to after it.
